one_line: Early Chahamana (Chauhan) ruler of Shakambhari who asserted sovereign authority in 10th-century Rajasthan.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early-40s, athletic and battle-hardened with a commander’s bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, wheatish-olive Rajput complexion, straight prominent nose, neatly trimmed full moustache that turns slightly upward, short close beard along the jawline, calm yet intense eyes with a default expression of steady, composed resolve.
appearance.hair: Dark brown-black hair gathered into a medium-length topknot at the back of the crown, sides smoothed back; a narrow gold circlet with a small central red gemstone sits low on the forehead, and a thin saffron cloth band is tied over the circlet, knot resting behind the right ear.
appearance.costume: Era-appropriate 10th-century Rajput attire: a knee-length, long-sleeved angarkha-style tunic of deep indigo cotton with wrap-over front and subtle woven geometric borders in muted gold along the neckline and hem; over it a sleeveless quilted cotton coat (kantha-like padding) in matte maroon with vertical stitch lines and a simple leather tie at the front; a broad mustard-yellow cloth kamarbandh wraps the waist, tails hanging to mid-thigh on the left; lower body in off-white, slightly tapered churidar-style trousers; feet in dark brown leather mojari shoes with modest upturned toes; over one shoulder a light, sand-coloured cotton patka with a thin red border is draped diagonally across the chest and tucked into the waist at the back; minimal jewellery limited to a pair of small plain gold hoop earrings and a simple thread amulet with a tiny metal charm barely visible at the neck.
appearance.signature: A single-edged early Rajput-style sword (similar to a proto-talwar) with a gently curved steel blade, simple iron crossguard, plain disc pommel wrapped in dark leather, and a sturdy brown leather scabbard worn suspended from a plain belt on his left hip, his right hand often resting lightly on the hilt.

ref_desc: Simharaja is a wheatish-olive Rajput king with an oval face, dark topknot under a gold circlet and saffron band, wearing a deep indigo angarkha, maroon quilted coat, mustard sash, off-white trousers, brown mojari shoes, and carrying a curved single-edged sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Simharaja of Shakambhari: a mid-30s Rajput king with an oval wheatish-olive face, strong jaw, straight nose, steady intense eyes, and a neatly trimmed full moustache with short jawline beard, shown with a calm, composed heroic expression. His dark brown-black hair is pulled into a medium topknot at the back of the crown, sides smoothed back, topped by a narrow gold circlet with a small central red gemstone, over which a thin saffron cloth band is tied with the knot behind his right ear. Dress him in a knee-length, long-sleeved deep indigo cotton angarkha with a wrap-over front and subtle muted-gold geometric borders on neckline and hem, over which sits a sleeveless maroon quilted cotton coat with vertical stitch lines and a simple leather tie at the front; wrap a broad mustard-yellow cloth sash firmly around his waist with its ends hanging to mid-thigh on his left. Give him off-white tapered churidar-style trousers and dark brown leather mojari shoes with modest upturned toes. Drape a light sand-coloured cotton patka with a thin red border diagonally over his right shoulder, crossing his chest and tucking into the back of his sash. Add small plain gold hoop earrings and a discreet thread amulet at his neck. At his left hip hang a gently curved single-edged steel sword in a brown leather scabbard on a simple belt, his right hand resting lightly on the hilt. Use a palette dominated by deep indigo, maroon, mustard yellow, off-white and dark brown, and show front, side, and back views to clearly display his consistent face, hair, clothing, and weapon details.
